LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.label: <color=#79CBFF>Warp Feather Beckoning</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_WarpFeather.description: After a brief cast, creates 12–24 Milira feathers. Cooldown: 300 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm.label: <color=#8BD5FF>Thunderseal Domain</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_ThunderMarkedStorm.description: Marks enemies within 3 cells. After a delay, each target receives 3 strikes, each dealing 35 base damage plus a 15-point EMP effect. Cooldown: 80 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage.label: <color=#79CBFF>Flowfeather Rend</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Bow_ArrowBarrage.description: Requires bow form. Charges for 5 seconds, then fires 32 arrows in the selected direction, each with 30 base damage and a 55-cell range. Cooldown: 120 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField.label: <color=#F39AD9>Flower Array: Prayer of Life</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_BlessingField.descriptio: Requires flower form. Heals wounds and scars on non-hostile flesh targets within 6 cells and improves mood. For 60 seconds, movement increases by 20%, incoming damage falls by 10%, and immunity gain increases by 70%. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden.label: <color=#D786E8>Flower Array: Miasma Garden</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Flower_ToxinGarden.description: Requires flower form. Inflicts food poisoning on enemies within 7 cells, with a 10% chance to cause berserk rage. Cooldown: 120 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall.label: <color=#8BD5FF>Sword Art: Skyfall</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_Skyfall.description: Requires sword form. Rises and marks the landing zone, dealing 120 armor-ignoring damage to enemies within 3 cells. They take 25% more damage for 25 seconds. Cooldown: 150 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead.label: <color=#C7A2F8>Sword Art: Beheading</color>
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Sword_ExecuteHead.description: Requires sword form. Retreats briefly, then dashes to the target and severs its head. Targets without a head take 75 armor-ignoring cut damage. Cooldown: 75 seconds.
